title: Keyboard not working
description: The keyboard on my desk stopped responding after the update.

title: Monitor flickering
description: Second monitor flickers intermittently, especially on video calls.

title: VPN drops every hour
description: Connection to the corporate VPN disconnects roughly every hour.
resolution: Updated VPN client to v4.2, connection now stable.

title: Printer queue stuck
description: Print jobs are queued but never sent to the printer on floor 3.
resolution: Cleared stuck job in print spooler.

title: Forgotten password
description: Cannot log in to the intranet after returning from leave.

title: Laptop battery drains fast
description: Battery drops from 100 to 30 percent in about two hours.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: Access denied when opening the finance shared folder.
resolution: Added user to the correct AD group.

title: Email attachments not opening
description: PDF attachments in Outlook fail to open with an error.
resolution: Reset file association to default PDF viewer.

title: Teams audio crackling
description: Audio crackles during Teams calls on the headset.
comments: Tried a different headset, same issue

title: Software install request
description: Requesting installation of R and RStudio on workstation.

title: Blue screen on startup
description: Machine shows a blue screen with error code 0x0000007B on boot.
resolution: Replaced failing SSD and restored image.

title: Wi-Fi weak in meeting room
description: Signal drops in the large meeting room on the 4th floor.

title: Outlook calendar not syncing
description: Calendar events added on phone do not appear in Outlook desktop.
resolution: Re-added the account and forced a sync.

title: Docking station not charging
description: Laptop does not charge when connected to the docking station.
resolution: Replaced faulty dock with a spare.
comments: Faulty dock returned to IT storage

title: Two-factor authentication locked
description: MFA app shows no accounts and cannot be re-enrolled.
resolution: Reset MFA and re-enrolled on new phone.

title: Slow file access on server
description: Opening large Excel files from the file server takes minutes.

title: Request new monitor
description: Current monitor has a dead pixel band; requesting replacement.

title: Webcam not detected
description: External webcam is not recognised after the latest OS update.
resolution: Rolled back USB driver, camera now works.

title: Shared mailbox permissions
description: Need read access to the support shared mailbox.
resolution: Granted read permissions via Exchange admin.

title: USB drive not mounting
description: Encrypted USB drive is not mounting on the new laptop.
comments: Drive works on the old laptop
